profile.summary: Alameda Alliance for Health is a local, public, not-for-profit managed care health plan that provides health coverage to Alameda County residents. It offers Alliance Medi-Cal, Alliance Group Care and Alliance Wellness (a Medicare plan). It is governed by a Board of Governors.
